; PROBE v2 (not part of the mod): map out ThumbnailProvider's real capability.
;
; Questions:
;  1. Is requestedSize honored-with-a-cap, or is a cached bitmap just served? v1 requested
;     954x1696 and got 288x512 — same aspect (954/288 == 1696/512 == 3.3125), height clamped
;     to 512, while the page's on-disk thumbnail is 384x512 (different aspect). So it looks
;     like an on-demand render clamped in height, NOT the cache file. Sweep sizes to find out.
;  2. Where is the ceiling? Ask for 1x, 2x, 4x screen and for a tiny size.
;  3. Does the URL carry parameters we can set ourselves? Log it in full.
;  4. Per-page or per-document? Render several page indices of the same doc.
;  5. Does an uncached page render fresh (and at what size)?
;  6. Does monochrome change resolution?
;
; Nothing is displayed: Images load even when invisible, so this only writes to the log.
; ThumbnailProvider accepts ONLY document/page/monochrome/source — assigning anything else
; (e.g. cache) is a compile error and crash-loops xochitl.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
	TRAVERSE ?#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: apiProbe
				visible: false

				property var doc: null
				property string docId: ""
				property bool ran: false

				function log(tag, msg) {
					console.log("APIPROBE " + tag + ": " + msg);
				}

				function dumpUrl(label, url) {
					var s = "" + url;
					apiProbe.log("URL " + label, "len=" + s.length);
					for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i += 150)
						apiProbe.log("URL " + label + "[" + i + "]", encodeURIComponent(s.substr(i, 150)));
				}

				function start() {
					if (apiProbe.ran) return;
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						try {
							var j = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
							if (!j.apiprobe || !j.docId) return;
							var d = Library.entryForId(j.docId);
							if (!d) { apiProbe.log("FAIL", "entryForId null"); return; }
							apiProbe.docId = j.docId;
							apiProbe.doc = d;
							apiProbe.ran = true;
							apiProbe.log("START", "doc=" + j.docId + " pageCount=" + d.pageCount);
							sizeSweep.model = [
								[0, 0], [200, 356], [477, 848], [954, 1696],
								[1908, 3392], [3816, 6784], [954, 954], [2000, 512]
							];
							var pages = [];
							for (var p = 30; p <= 45; p++) pages.push(p);
							pages.push(Math.max(0, d.pageCount - 1));
							pageSweep.model = pages;
							monoSweep.model = [true, false];
							monoSizeSweep.model = [
								[200, 356], [477, 848], [954, 1696], [1908, 3392], [954, 954]
							];
						} catch (e) {
							apiProbe.log("FAIL", "state read: " + e);
						}
					};
					xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json");
					xhr.send();
				}

				// 1-3: same page, many requested sizes
				Repeater {
					id: sizeSweep
					model: []
					delegate: Item {
						required property var modelData
						ThumbnailProvider {
							id: sp
							document: apiProbe.doc
							page: 0
							monochrome: false
						}
						Image {
							source: sp.source
							asynchronous: true
							cache: false
							sourceSize: (parent.modelData[0] === 0)
								? undefined
								: Qt.size(parent.modelData[0], parent.modelData[1])
							onStatusChanged: {
								var req = parent.modelData[0] + "x" + parent.modelData[1];
								if (status === Image.Ready) {
									apiProbe.log("SIZE", "requested " + req
										+ " -> implicit " + implicitWidth + "x" + implicitHeight);
									if (parent.modelData[0] === 954) apiProbe.dumpUrl("954", sp.source);
									if (parent.modelData[0] === 0) apiProbe.dumpUrl("native", sp.source);
								} else if (status === Image.Error) {
									apiProbe.log("SIZE", "requested " + req + " -> ERROR");
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}

				// 4-5: per-page? uncached page?
				Repeater {
					id: pageSweep
					model: []
					delegate: Item {
						id: pageDel
						required property int modelData
						// NB: ThumbnailProvider is NOT an Item, so `parent` does not resolve
						// to the delegate inside it — reference the delegate by id instead.
						ThumbnailProvider {
							id: pp
							document: apiProbe.doc
							page: pageDel.modelData
							monochrome: false
						}
						Image {
							source: pp.source
							asynchronous: true
							cache: false
							sourceSize: Qt.size(954, 1696)
							onStatusChanged: {
								if (status === Image.Loading) return;
								var u = "" + pp.source;
								var m = u.match(/thumbnails\/([0-9a-f-]+)\.png/);
								apiProbe.log("PAGE", "page " + pageDel.modelData
									+ " status=" + (status === Image.Ready ? "READY" : "ERROR")
									+ " " + implicitWidth + "x" + implicitHeight
									+ " thumb=" + (m ? m[1] : "NO-FILE-IN-URL"));
							}
						}
					}
				}

				// 7: mono=true returned 954x1696 where mono=false capped at 288x512 —
				// is the mono path re-rendering, or just upscaling the same 384x512 file?
				// If implicit tracks the request exactly at every size, it is pure upscale.
				Repeater {
					id: monoSizeSweep
					model: []
					delegate: Item {
						id: msDel
						required property var modelData
						ThumbnailProvider {
							id: msp
							document: apiProbe.doc
							page: 0
							monochrome: true
						}
						Image {
							source: msp.source
							asynchronous: true
							cache: false
							sourceSize: Qt.size(msDel.modelData[0], msDel.modelData[1])
							onStatusChanged: {
								if (status === Image.Ready)
									apiProbe.log("MONOSIZE", "requested "
										+ msDel.modelData[0] + "x" + msDel.modelData[1]
										+ " -> implicit " + implicitWidth + "x" + implicitHeight);
								else if (status === Image.Error)
									apiProbe.log("MONOSIZE", "requested "
										+ msDel.modelData[0] + "x" + msDel.modelData[1] + " -> ERROR");
							}
						}
					}
				}

				// 6: monochrome
				Repeater {
					id: monoSweep
					model: []
					delegate: Item {
						id: monoDel
						required property bool modelData
						ThumbnailProvider {
							id: mp
							document: apiProbe.doc
							page: 0
							monochrome: monoDel.modelData
						}
						Image {
							source: mp.source
							asynchronous: true
							cache: false
							sourceSize: Qt.size(954, 1696)
							onStatusChanged: {
								if (status === Image.Ready)
									apiProbe.log("MONO", "monochrome=" + monoDel.modelData
										+ " -> implicit " + implicitWidth + "x" + implicitHeight
										+ " url=" + ("" + mp.source).replace(/\s+/g, ""));
							}
						}
					}
				}

				Connections {
					target: root
					function onDocumentChanged() { apiProbe.start(); }
					function onPageChanged() { apiProbe.start(); }
				}

				Component.onCompleted: apiProbe.start()
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
